purpose: Run actual Cisco2.2.1 static scanning in one retained offline image; no model-backed analyzer or candidate execution.
new_dependencies: Exactly the already cached/verified91 mandatory dependencies plus selected scanner2.2.1. Separate private image preserves OpenAI2.x/Rich14.x pins without changing retained SDK runtimes.
permitted_cleanup: Only new container names proven absent before dispatch, then rechecked by exact review label, immutable image ID and container ID. Normal --rm and at most two stop/remove calls; no image/volume/cache deletion or force.
payload_scope: Exactly the existing public format-json candidate bytes excluding evaluation answers, plus an authored textual prompt-injection detection control. Candidate bytes are scanned, never executed or disclosed externally. Findings and analyzer failures are retained in minimized fields; a security qualification is not inferred.
permissions: Docker containers:network none,read-only image,nonroot65532,all caps dropped,no-new-privileges,pids128,memory1GiB,CPU2,one64MiB noexec tmpfs. No host bind mounts,home,socket,credentials,ports or persistent volumes.
accounting_scope: Existing receipt store/reservations and separate exact finite numeric engineering grant. No existing assessment counters or ceilings change. Build/probe/scan/owned cleanup costs are retained; bootstrap/finalization overhead incomplete and Docker-client resources are not scanner-worker measurements.
evidence_scope: Actual upstream static scanner engineering only; not candidate/selection usefulness, both-domain workflow completion, resource acceptance or release. First-party substitutes do not close this gate. Canonical all-integration observation assembly remains separate.
attempt_policy: One image build and exact bounded calls. Preserve terminal failures and all charges. No upstream source,worker,payload,dependency,permission or spending changes; no uncertain replay. Routine first-party bookkeeping corrections for unstarted phases remain within standing delegation and must retain exact amended hashes and finite remaining limits.
